description: In every PA-model, the actual parameterized fold retains the parameter in its paired accumulator.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.paramFold_parameter_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program 3) (c p z : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.unpairLeft.value
      ![(Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.foldInto
              (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.paramFoldStep h)).value
          ![c, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.squarePair.value ![p, z]]] =
    p
